expect.grant: Metadata read, Contents read and write, Issues read and write, Actions read and write

handover.breaks: every claudinite-fleet-sheepdog sweep fails — and a token short one permission fails only on the sweep that needs it, which can be a week later, on the one sweep that writes or dispatches
handover.done: the secret exists and each claudinite-fleet-sheepdog task's next run is green
handover.step: Create a fine-grained PAT on this account covering ALL repositories, granted Metadata read, Contents read and write, Issues read and write, Actions read and write, and add it to this repo as the Actions secret FLEET_GITHUB_TOKEN. Grant every permission listed, not the subset the first sweep you run needs.

hint./actions/workflows/dispatches: — the FLEET_GITHUB_TOKEN PAT is most likely missing Actions: read and write (the two fan-out sweeps dispatch another member's scheduler workflow, which is an Actions write)
hint./repos/a/b: — the FLEET_GITHUB_TOKEN PAT is most likely missing Metadata: read (every sweep enumerates the owner's repositories before it does anything else)
hint./repos/a/b/actions/workflows/w/dispatche: — the FLEET_GITHUB_TOKEN PAT is most likely missing Actions: read and write (the two fan-out sweeps dispatch another member's scheduler workflow, which is an Actions write)
hint./repos/a/b/contents/x: — the FLEET_GITHUB_TOKEN PAT is most likely missing Contents: read and write (every sweep reads each member's declaration; the pack-seed sweep writes one back, so read alone is not enough)
hint./repos/a/b/issues?labels=fleet-adoption: — the FLEET_GITHUB_TOKEN PAT is most likely missing Issues: read and write (the roster and seed sweeps converge labelled issues in this repo, and the missing-packs sweep files a work-list issue in each member)
hint./repos/a/b/labels: — the FLEET_GITHUB_TOKEN PAT is most likely missing Issues: read and write (the roster and seed sweeps converge labelled issues in this repo, and the missing-packs sweep files a work-list issue in each member)
hint./repos/a/b?x=1: — the FLEET_GITHUB_TOKEN PAT is most likely missing Metadata: read (every sweep enumerates the owner's repositories before it does anything else)
hint./user/repos: — the FLEET_GITHUB_TOKEN PAT is most likely missing Metadata: read (every sweep enumerates the owner's repositories before it does anything else)
hint./user/repos?affiliation=owner: — the FLEET_GITHUB_TOKEN PAT is most likely missing Metadata: read (every sweep enumerates the owner's repositories before it does anything else)
